title: Expand buffer cache and align planner I/O costs to cut physical reads
configuration_cause: shared_buffers=16384 (128MB) is tiny versus 2TB RAM; blks_read_per_txn=1.51 vs blks_hit_per_txn=9.23 (~14% miss) and random_page_cost=4.0 overprices cached random reads, so GetUserTweets (88.5% terminal capacity) pays physical I/O.
mechanism: GetUserTweets dominates terminal capacity (0.885) and its p50=196us is inflated by physical reads: blks_read_per_txn 1.51 against blks_hit 9.23. Raising shared_buffers to 65536 (512MB) retains the hot tweet/user working set; raising effective_cache_size to 1048576 tells the planner most reads are cached; effective_io_concurrency=8 enables prefetch; lowering random_page_cost to 1.1 and seq_page_cost to 0.9 makes index paths on cached pages cheaper. Together they should cut blks_read_per_txn and GetUserTweets latency, freeing terminal capacity for more completed transactions.
query_effect: Index scans on tweet/user tables should hit shared_buffers instead of disk; planner prefers index paths on cached pages, reducing GetUserTweets p50 and p95.
expected_tps_effect: Increase successful_transaction_tps by reducing GetUserTweets terminal occupancy.
expected_latency_effect: Decrease GetUserTweets p50/p95; overall p95 modestly lower.

predictions.rationale: Larger cache plus cache-aware planner costs reduce physical block reads.
Fewer physical reads shorten the dominant transaction's median.
Lower terminal occupancy on GetUserTweets frees capacity for completed transactions.

alternatives.statement: If buffer expansion does not move blks_read_per_txn, the residual is WAL sync latency (sync_average_ms 0.131) and the wal_commit_path bundle is the better lever.
If blks_read_per_txn falls but TPS is flat, the bottleneck is client terminal serialization rather than storage and cache tuning is exhausted.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent leaves shared_buffers at 128MB with a 14% buffer miss and default planner costs; the mandatory buffer_cache_capacity bundle directly targets the active low_buffer_hit_ratio phenomenon and the dominant GetUserTweets transaction.

nodes.label: Raise shared_buffers/effective_cache_size, lower random/seq_page_cost, raise effective_io_concurrency
Hot working set retained in cache; planner prefers cached index paths

knob_changes.numerical_basis: 4x current 128MB to 512MB, within safe [8192,65536]; 2TB RAM leaves ample headroom.
Raise from 1 to 8 for prefetch, within safe [0,256].
Lower toward cached-read cost, within safe [1.0,6.0].
Slight decrease paired with random_page_cost, within safe [0.5,2.0].
knob_changes.mechanism_role: I/O cost scale paired with random_page_cost
